div.div: بَهْلَةٌ (S, Mgh, K) and ↓ بُهْلَةٌ (S, Msb, K) A curse: (S, Mgh, Msb, K:) from بَهَلَ النَّاقَةَ in the sense first explained above. (Bd in iii. 54.) You say, عَلَيْهِ بَهْلَةُ ٱللّٰهِ and ↓ بُهْلَتُهُ The curse of God be on him! (S.) For another ex., see 3.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
